_about: Monta FG4, a fixed-grip quad from our fictional French maker: a recreation built by our scripts from the owner's reference model's dimensions (measured locally; the model is never named). Millimetres, each terminal in its own lift frame: origin on the bullwheel's axle at the station's grade, u toward the line, v right, w up. The drive is the bottom station, the return the top.
_adjust: one straight rope line per side on the exit trains' line (gauge 4895): the wheel's rope channel is deepened to it and the return's sheaves move onto it sideways
drive exit trains rise 38 mm and guide sheaves drop 17 mm so the rope (3039 after the lowering) touches every sheave
the wheel carriage is the reference's C-frames, open where the wheel turns (no slot)
the hood's panels between its outer ribs are tinted glass over a dark lining, after the owner's photos of these terminals in the wild

both terminals are lowered to the Sessellift chair's rope height (3039), the owner's call, so the lift carries that chair unchanged: the drive's leaning legs are cut along their lean (its piers slide 353 mm toward the wheel) and everything above drops 612 mm; the return's diagonal strut and its column are cut (the strut's pad slides 703 mm toward the column) and everything above drops 703 mm
the return's two pads carry on down as footings to 2.5 m below grade (LP7), as every terminal's do; nothing changes above grade
